parent.interpretation_boundary: H is only the arithmetic residual request-wall minus observed token-GPU execution; no specific host/runtime mechanism is established.

allowed_parent_information: Final CORE-0D-R1 G/H verdict and frozen Amdahl decision.
Source-level phase boundary semantics already frozen in benchmark-only adapters/materializers.
Exact model, trajectory, instrumentation and execution contracts.
forbidden_parent_use: Do not inspect or rank CORE-0D-R1 PHASE_ONLY phase magnitudes to choose CORE-0E buckets.
Do not use parent phase timing outcomes to set phase thresholds or merge/split buckets.
Do not use parent phase magnitudes as CORE-0E primary evidence.

scientific_question: Under the exact common teacher-forced ArcLLM-vs-llama.cpp regime, can H_OUTSIDE_TOKEN_GPU be prospectively decomposed into a closed set of cross-system temporal phases, and does exactly one phase carry enough robust recoverable current-wall excess to deserve the next attribution study?

immutable_contract.token_gpu_definition: Exactly the CORE-0D-R1 G definition: ArcLLM prefill device-span plus 31 decode device-spans; llama block-0 prefill total plus blocks 1-31 decode totals.
immutable_contract.outside_gpu_definition: H_system = W_system - G_system; DeltaH = H_arc - H_llama

phase_partition.principle: Cross-system temporal phases only. No phase is named after an unproven mechanism such as model-loading, Vulkan-init, CPU orchestration, allocation or I/O.

child_science_window.arcllm_start: First benchmark-only timestamp at entry to the diagnostic derivative of arcllm::v1::runtime::generate, before request validation/model mapping.
child_science_window.arcllm_end: Timestamp after existing canonical runtime teardown/cleanup has completed and immediately before any CORE-0E phase-sidecar serialization.
child_science_window.llama_start: Timestamp immediately before the benchmark-only llama runtime/backend initialization sequence begins.
child_science_window.llama_end: Timestamp immediately after llama context/model/backend teardown completes and before CORE-0E phase-sidecar serialization.
child_science_window.result_serialization_rule: CORE-0E diagnostic adapters must place ordinary result serialization outside the child science window on both systems. Existing inference/model semantics must not change.
child_science_window.sidecar_rule: CORE-0E phase-sidecar serialization occurs only after child_science_window_end and is therefore part of PROCESS_ENVELOPE by definition.

marker_semantics.prefill_wall_start: Immediately before the single prefill model-evaluation call/submit.
marker_semantics.prefill_wall_end: Immediately after the full-vocabulary finite/top-1 scan following prefill.
marker_semantics.decode_wall_start: Immediately before the first forced cached-decode input is submitted.
marker_semantics.decode_wall_end: Immediately after the full-vocabulary finite/top-1 scan following cached-decode step 31.
marker_semantics.decode_transition: Diagnostic subinterval only: decode_wall_start - prefill_wall_end. It must be non-negative and is included inside P3_DECODE_HOST; it is not a sixth attribution phase.

P0_PROCESS_ENVELOPE.contains_by_definition: OS/process launch, argument/setup work outside the child science window, ordinary result serialization, CORE-0E phase-sidecar serialization, process exit and parent-observation residual.
P0_PROCESS_ENVELOPE.interpretation_boundary: Do not rename this process-launch cost or I/O cost without a successor study.

P1_PRE_TOKEN.contains_by_definition: All in-window work before the prefill evaluation begins.
P1_PRE_TOKEN.interpretation_boundary: May include model/runtime/backend setup and materialization, but CORE-0E does not identify which mechanism causes excess.

P2_PREFILL_HOST.contains_by_definition: Non-token-GPU duration inside the prefill wall interval, including host orchestration/full-vocabulary scan and any waiting not represented by G_prefill.
P2_PREFILL_HOST.interpretation_boundary: Do not call it CPU-only; it is an arithmetic non-G residual.

P3_DECODE_HOST.contains_by_definition: All non-token-GPU duration after the prefill scan through the final cached-decode scan, including the prefill-to-first-decode transition, host orchestration/full-vocabulary scans and any waiting not represented by G_decode.
P3_DECODE_HOST.interpretation_boundary: Do not call it CPU-only; it is an arithmetic non-G residual over the complete post-prefill-through-decode-end interval.

P4_POST_TOKEN.contains_by_definition: All in-window work after the final decode scan through runtime/model/backend teardown.
P4_POST_TOKEN.interpretation_boundary: Do not rename this cleanup/teardown cost without a successor study.

exact_identities: H_system = P0 + P1 + P2 + P3 + P4
phase_partition.negative_cross_system_phase_excess: Preserve negative DeltaP values; never clamp to zero.

arc_requirements: Combine frozen CORE-0D-R1 Token-XRay GPU tracing with the six monotonic absolute phase markers in the same request.
Do not alter canonical ArcLLM runtime/kernel/shader sources.
llama_requirements: Use the same pinned llama.cpp commit and built-in GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER numeric grammar qualified by CORE-0D-R1.
Add only benchmark-adapter monotonic absolute phase markers; do not patch llama.cpp source.
Ordinary result serialization and phase-sidecar serialization occur outside child_science_window; inference and teardown semantics remain otherwise unchanged.
implementation_contract.clocks: Use one monotonic clock within each child process for all child markers. Parent external wall remains the runner monotonic wall clock.
implementation_contract.performance_authority: CORE-0B uninstrumented child wall remains the product performance authority.

collection_design.name: CORE0E_FRESH_PHASE_ATTRIBUTION
collection_design.adjacency_rule: Within each mode the two systems form an adjacent matched pair before moving to the next mode.

pass_if: Exact frozen model, W-S/W-C prompt and 31 teacher-forced decode inputs are used.
Both systems execute exactly one prefill plus 31 cached-decode calls.
Full-vocabulary finite/top-1 scans remain present after prefill and every decode call.
Predicted top-1 tokens are recorded but never fed back.
All three CONTROL ArcLLM/llama ratios are > 1 per workload.
Per-workload CONTROL median is within multiplicative factor 1.5 of the frozen CORE-0B median.
Per-workload max_ratio/min_ratio <= 2.5.
All six COMBINED_PHASE_TRACE matched pairs retain positive total ArcLLM excess DeltaE.
Per-workload COMBINED_PHASE_TRACE median ArcLLM/llama wall ratio is within multiplicative factor 1.5 of that workload's CONTROL median.
All six child markers exist, are finite monotonic timestamps, and follow the frozen strict order.
child_science_window, P1, prefill_wall, decode_transition, decode_wall and P4 are non-negative.
ArcLLM preserves exactly 1 prefill Token-XRay trace and 31 decode traces with frozen 441/469 geometry, 451 semantic nodes and 100% timestamp coverage.
llama preserves exactly 32 structurally qualified Vulkan timing groups: group 0 prefill, groups 1-31 decode.
G_prefill and G_decode are positive finite.
P2 = prefill_wall-G_prefill and P3 = (decode_wall_end-prefill_wall_end)-G_decode are non-negative on every request.
P0 = external_child_wall-child_science_window is non-negative on every request.
Per request, child_science_window equals P1 + prefill_wall + (decode_wall_end-prefill_wall_end) + P4 within 1 microsecond.
Per request, H_system = W-G equals P0+P1+P2+P3+P4 within 1 microsecond.
Per matched pair, DeltaH equals sum(DeltaP0..DeltaP4) within 1 microsecond.
No negative cross-system DeltaP is clamped or rewritten.
DeltaH > 0 on all six COMBINED_PHASE_TRACE matched pairs.
median(f_H) > 0 in both workloads.
q_H >= 0.10 in both workloads.
At least one workload has q_H >= 0.20.

reporting: Preserve all three block values per workload.
Report median/min/max/MAD for P values, DeltaP, f_P and h_P.
Report W-S and W-C separately; do not pool before phase selection.
Preserve negative DeltaP, f_P and h_P values exactly.

phase_eligibility: At least one workload has q_Pk >= 0.20.

single_phase_priority_rule.decision: Select exactly one phase only if eligible, score >= 0.15, and score exceeds the runner-up phase by >= 0.05 absolute current-wall fraction. Otherwise return NO_SINGLE_OUTSIDE_GPU_PHASE_PRIORITY.

phase_amdahl_gate.note: Thresholds intentionally reuse the frozen CORE-0D-R1 region-level materiality/winner rules instead of inventing weaker phase-specific thresholds after seeing parent data.

forbidden_inferences: P0 must not be called process-launch or I/O bottleneck.
P1 must not be called model-load or Vulkan-init bottleneck.
P2/P3 must not be called CPU bottlenecks.
P4 must not be called cleanup bottleneck.
No phase winner authorizes optimization; it authorizes only the routed successor attribution study.

amendment.reason: Zero-science static closure QA found that the strict six-marker ordering permits a positive interval between prefill_wall_end and decode_wall_start. Under v0.1 that interval belonged to none of P0-P4, so the preregistered exact child-window/H closure identity was not structurally guaranteed. No measured CORE-0E request had been authorized or executed when this defect was found.
amendment.change_scope: Phase-boundary arithmetic only. No workload, model, trajectory, instrumentation, ordering, transfer threshold, Amdahl threshold, successor-selection rule or mechanism hypothesis changes.
amendment.repair: Retain all six strict markers and all five phases. Define a decode_transition interval = decode_wall_start - prefill_wall_end for diagnostics, and define P3_DECODE_HOST over the complete post-prefill-through-decode-end interval: P3 = (decode_wall_end - prefill_wall_end) - G_decode. Thus P3 includes the decode-transition residual plus the non-G residual inside the 31-step decode wall.
